_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_BlackBook/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_BlackBook/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Checked against the code 2026-10-20: BlackBook has no accounts at all (noAccounts in src/main.tsx, every build), so no email, no user id and no signed-in usage events, and with noAccounts the SDK's anonymous daily open count is off too (the suite install id was retired in @unisim/sdk 0.187.0), so no Device or other IDs and no App interactions. The address book lives on the device. The encrypted online vault was removed with sign-in on 2026-10-20; a backup file the user saves themselves (optionally password-encrypted, AES-256-GCM / PBKDF2) replaced it, and it goes wherever the user sends it through the share sheet, never to us. Phone contacts are read on the device only when the user asks (READ_CONTACTS, never write) and leave it only inside a backup or CSV file the user saves, so Contacts is not declared. So: no data collected. Re-import this at the next Play release, and set App access to no special access. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and PRIVACY.md.
